correctness.rationale: Five distinct fifth-root evaluations resolve the five modes −2,…,2. At the two positive radii the second mode kills H20, and invertibility of the first-mode 2×2 system kills H10 and H21. On the diagonal the polynomial in the squared radius must be a real multiple of (x−r²)(x−s²). Thus the kernel is exactly the stated full-rank K. Negative t leaves a negative direction in the intersection of q-perp with the two outer coordinate directions. For positive t, the outer block t diag(r²s²,1)+vv* is positive definite; the complementary scalar is t[|q1|²/(t+|q0|²/(r²s²)+|q2|²)−(r²+s²)]. Its sign and nullity give the closed segment and ranks, including the singleton cases. A difference of two matrices of rank at most one has rank at most two, so the rank-three kernel yields uniqueness there. Any off-circle sample evaluates K to (u²−r²)(u²−s²) and removes the only obstruction. The trace-one example has disjoint supports and the stated intensities; the Gaussian transform identity follows from the Fourier integral of a translated Gaussian.
residual_risks: Rank transitions refer to a nontrivial fiber; q=0 gives a singleton of rank zero. This is exact noiseless injectivity, not a stability result.

originality.rationale: There is substantial demonstrable coverage independent of the order of publication. For the same arbitrary two radii, the distinct rotated-square record proves exactly the same one-dimensional Hermitian kernel using eight samples rather than ten. Equality of the kernels makes the two measurement maps equivalent for every Hermitian fiber, not just for vectors. The stated PSD segment and its ranks are the elementary rank-one update of that same kernel, and the extra-radius statement is its direct scalar evaluation. The differing grids and fixed-Gaussian interpretation do not supply a materially distinct PSD finding. This is a scientific overlap decision, not priority attribution from a shared date.
residual_risks: No priority order is inferred for the same-day records. The general web search did not provide additional useful evidence; the decision rests on the exact inspected match and its algebraic implication.

value.rationale: The distinction between vector retrieval and PSD recovery is meaningful, and the formula is a useful explanation of it. As a separate exact mathematical contribution here, however, it is a one-variable PSD intersection mechanically determined by the already matched kernel. The five-angle grid adds a simpler way to derive that kernel but neither a different feasibility invariant nor better sample count, and there is no separate noise or stability result.
residual_risks: A different sampling or stability theorem could have separate value, but is not established by this record.
